scope: explicit selected structural wall side / independent room floor; furniture and fixed counters are not selection targets
source: Existing project-authored S2 Blender CPU samples, 2026-10-22. Reused without map-byte modification. Not VLMaterial or SuperMat outputs.
rights: Original project-authored outputs, no separate redistribution license declared. No new third-party pack; not labelled CC0. These samples already accompany the approved 168C PBR revision.

channels.MR: G=roughness, B=0 metallic, R=255 unused; factor roughness1 metalness0
channels.normal: OpenGL tangent-space +Y. New sample scalar1; current derivative-tangent Three basis is [1,-1], tangent attributes use [1,1]. Original loader materials/signs are untouched. No channel inversion.

uv.repeat: source texture_repeat_m / 1.2; default1.2 only when metadata absent
uv.basis: existing source generator design convention; not measured installed material or verified physical normal relief
uv.transform: new matching complete map set uses identical UV transform; original maps and transforms remain on the original material

thumbnails: CSS-native schematic swatches in src/walkthrough/material-dock.css; no raster thumbnails or network images are loaded on opening. They are color/material cues, not photographs.
loading: No texture request until explicit material-card action, promise cache by sample; failures retry. Restoring an explicitly saved override also loads required samples.
